# pdm-old

Generated 2026-11-12 by a real tool in a throwaway container. Neither file was
edited by hand afterwards, and pdm did not change pyproject.toml. pdm 2.5.6,
the first version tried, installed with plain pip (no extra pins) and locked
against today's PyPI. It writes the old layout with hashes in
`[metadata.files]`.

- Tool: PDM 2.5.6, installed with pip 23.0.1.
- Image: `python:3.10-slim` (CPython 3.10.22), digest
  `sha256:6ff506466f8b1e981719b468cc0023b8ef000b983cdec0eafe119d01f379e31d`.
  git 2.47.3 was installed from Debian because pdm clones VCS requirements with it.
- Commands (pyproject.toml was hand-written first; only `pdm lock` was run, never `pdm install`/`sync`):

      docker run --rm -v <scratch>/pdm-old:/work -w /work python:3.10-slim sh -c '
        apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git
        pip install "pdm==2.5.6"
        PDM_NON_INTERACTIVE=1 PDM_CHECK_UPDATE=false PDM_VENV_IN_PROJECT=false pdm lock -v'

  Tool-environment versions pip picked: unearth 0.19.0, resolvelib 1.2.1, findpython 0.9.0, packaging 26.3, installer 0.7.0, cachecontrol 0.14.4, virtualenv 21.15.6. pdm creates an empty virtualenv under `/root/.local/share/pdm/venvs` inside the container, and it was discarded with the container. The `.pdm-python` pointer file it writes was not copied. pdm cloned sampleproject and read its static metadata, so no build backend ran.

Manifest: PEP 621 `[project]` with `requires-python = ">=3.9"`. The main dependencies include the git dependency as a PEP 508 direct reference, `sampleproject @ git+https://github.com/pypa/sampleproject@main`. The dev group uses the old pdm form, `[tool.pdm.dev-dependencies] dev = ["iniconfig==2.0.0"]`, because pdm 2.5 predates PEP 735 `[dependency-groups]`.

Notable features of pdm.lock (the old lock layout):
- Header `# This file is @generated by PDM.`. `[metadata]` comes after the packages: `lock_version = "4.2"`, `groups = ["default", "dev"]`, `content_hash = "sha256:..."`. There is no `strategy` and no `[[metadata.targets]]`.
- 9 `[[package]]` entries: certifi 2026.10.23, charset-normalizer 3.5.2, idna 3.20, iniconfig 2.0.0, packaging 24.1, peppercorn 0.6, requests 2.32.3, sampleproject 4.0.0 (git) and urllib3 2.6.3.
- Packages have no `groups`/`marker`/`files` keys. The lock alone cannot tell that iniconfig is dev-only: only `[metadata] groups` says a `dev` group was locked, and the membership is in pyproject.toml.
- Hashes are in a separate `[metadata.files]` table keyed by `"<name> <version>"`, e.g. `"certifi 2026.10.23" = [{url = "https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/.../certifi-2026.10.23-py3-none-any.whl", hash = "sha256:..."}, ...]`. Entries carry full `url`s, not `file` names. charset-normalizer has 172 entries, every other registry package 2. The git package `sampleproject` has NO key in `[metadata.files]`. There is a double blank line before `[metadata.files]`, as written by pdm.
- Dependency edges are PEP 508 strings in `dependencies = [...]` (requests → `"urllib3<3,>=1.21.1"` etc., sampleproject → `"peppercorn"`). peppercorn has no `requires_python` key.
- urllib3 is 2.6.3. 2.8.0 and 2.7.0 require Python >=3.10, and the lock targets `>=3.9`.
- Git dependency `sampleproject` 4.0.0 has `git = "https://github.com/pypa/sampleproject"`, `ref = "main"`, `revision = "621e4974ca25ce531773def586ba3ed8e736b3fc"`.
- Deviation from the request: the git dependency was meant to be pinned at tag `v4.0.0`, but https://github.com/pypa/sampleproject has no tags at all (`git ls-remote` shows only `HEAD` and `refs/heads/main`). The branch `main` was used instead. It resolves to 621e4974ca25ce531773def586ba3ed8e736b3fc, "pyproject: prep 4.0.0 (#219)", whose pyproject.toml declares version 4.0.0. That is the commit a v4.0.0 tag would point at.
